title: Strategy detail says in plain words what the strategy does and how it is doing
scope: functional evidence only; hosted verification is done later by the operator acceptance task. No VM or SSH access was used and no operator key was read.

problem_register_binding.operator_approval: 2026-11-25 conversation 52a1dacf (照建議 全部處理好)

details: deduplicateStrategyRules in strategyRuleText.ts orders traded rules (pool_envelope, pool_member, trading) first and rollback_baseline rules last.
StrategyRulesList in StrategySpecTab.tsx renders rollback_baseline in a collapsed <details> line at the end of the list with a plain-language summary hint and full rule details inside.

formatPoolCombinationRule and formatPoolRiskLimits format clipped_weighted_sum_v1, max_net_strength, and gross_weight_limit as plain sentences in zh-TW and en-US with the raw code preserved in the title tooltip, and render any unknown code as secondary monospace text.

The overview performance block (data-testid='strategy-performance-block') renders four StatCards: Cumulative Paper PnL (with metricsAsOf hint or recorded metricsReason when missing), Drawdown (with recorded metricsReason when missing), Trades (totalTrades or recorded reason/No data when absent), and Runtime status (runtimeStatus with plain runtimeStatusReason sentence and raw reason code in tooltip, falling back to operationalStatus when runtimeStatus is absent).
PnL 30d, Sharpe, and Alpha rows/subtitles are removed from the overview.
When the new BFF fields (pnl, drawdown, totalTrades, runtimeStatus, metricsReason) are absent, all missing cards render No data / 無資料 and nothing is shown as zero.

The Strategy State card (data-testid='strategy-triple-state-card'), its three axes (Lifecycle / Review / Deployment), every lifecycle/review/deployment value, and invariant ok ('狀態一致' / 'State consistent') are translated in zh-TW and en-US via strategyLifecycleLabel, strategyReviewLabel, and strategyDeploymentLabel.

A strategy that runs through its persona pool (has capitalPoolId, pool_envelope/pool_member rules, or active bound persona runtime) renders '透過 Persona 策略池執行' / 'Runs through persona pool' instead of deployment 'none'.

Header and tab action buttons use localized plain names via actionLabel(tr.action, t) and t('strategyDetail.actions.inspect') without arrow text such as 'promote_paper → paper' or 'archive → archived'.

Disabled NonProductionActionButton controls provide plain-language reasons in zh-TW and en-US explaining why they are disabled on this read-only page, with a visible read-only hint in the action bar and no changes to action behaviour or permissions.
Every object ID on StrategyDetail overview (strategy.id, personaId, capitalPoolId, and each rule registryId) is rendered as secondary text exactly once per object.

Focused tests in StrategyDetail.test.tsx and poolRules.ts exercise the recorded rules and runtime/metric shapes of the three live strategies: strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa, strategy-persona-06d4775a9b6a8f63b311, and strategy-persona-039ad01f8bcd2b4aa466.

At 1274x627, e2e/06-entity-registry.spec.ts captures a Chromium browser screenshot of the overview for strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa against the fixture BFF at docs/deployment/evidence/FE-STRATEGY-DETAIL-PLAIN-WORDS-20261125/strategy-detail-overview-1274x627.png.
1:1 zh-TW and en-US locale parity is verified in enumLabels.test.ts and i18nParity.test.ts.
